dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: So, this your secret base?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Pretty spacious here, but I get a sense of comfort too, somehow.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Suppose it's because I don't sense any danger here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you settling in okay?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, don't worry about me, I'm very adaptable.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Once, when my old man and I were pursuing the Wild Hunt to the northern lands, we accidentally stumbled into a Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: There were countless monsters inside. The veteran Ratniki and I fought for three days and nights before we finally found the exit and retreated.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And despite all that, I managed to sneak naps in between enemy attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: My old man said he thought I was scared stiff, seeing as how I'd fallen asleep before my eyes even closed, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But here, I don't have to constantly keep an ear out for distant alarms, or be worried if the enemy will suddenly attack all night.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I can get a good night's sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Only problem is... Well, you've put me out of a job.

choices.text: Then get the rest you deserve.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Easy for you to say, but now that I can suddenly just relax, I feel strangely empty inside.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: And I can't help but wonder if I'll have trouble readjusting to the rhythm of a life of war.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't you have anything you want to do?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Hmm... Nope, not really.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Now that I think about it, I hone my combat skills to protect everyone, and study cooking to make food for everyone.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: ...I can't think of a single thing I do just for myself...

choices.text: Then let's start thinking about it now, eh?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yeah. Sounds like a good call.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Well then, I'll treat your suggestion as my next "job".

choices.text: Then let's go make some new friends, shall we?
Don't even think about work while you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Of course, that's exactly what I was thinking. I just happened to be wondering where to find you, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Nothing in particular, but friends should meet often, shouldn't they?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Unlike my colleagues, who operate from fixed locations, adventurers like you come and go like the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: See, if I want to visit Mr. Flins, all I need to do is visit the lighthouse during the day a few extra times, keep knocking, and I'll find him eventually.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And if I want to contact Miss Nefer, even if I can't find her in person, I can leave a message at the Curatorium of Secrets to schedule a meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: By comparison, finding you is much harder. After all, you're often out adventuring, and might not even be in Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll come by to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Haha, sounds like something I would say. Never thought I'd be on the receiving end.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Thanks! Still, would be better if I had a way to contact you anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Could we get Miss Aino to invent some kind of instant messaging device? To be honest, we Ratniki could really use something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It might be faster to just post a commission.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Huh. I didn't think of that. It does have "adventurer" written all over it...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Right, wrote it down. You can look forward to receiving a commission to "guard a camp with the Ratniki."

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: As for the commission itself... you'll spend the whole day playing cards with my colleagues and me.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Though, I'm still not sure how good you are yet... Maybe we should have Mr. Flins join too...

choices.text: No need to be so serious about it.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Haha, games are all about winning, though! I can't help but get serious.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yes, the match will be one for the record books.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Haha, then call them all! Anyone you consider a friend is welcome amongst us Lightkeepers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Well, what I have been doing is studying your secret base. It's every bit as mysterious as I expected, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You'd think it'd be full of openings and weaknesses, but no, it's a sealed-in world unto itself.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Even Aedon might have a hard time sneaking out.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But then again, if monsters were to get into this teapot and bar the entrance...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Wouldn't that put those inside in danger?

choices.text: Monsters can't get in though, can they?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Probably... but that isn't a guarantee they won't attack, is it?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: They could, for example, take the form of someone you know, then sneak in when you're not paying attention.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is something like that even possible...?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: If something isn't 100% impossible, then there's a possibility it'll happen, right?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: And as they say, nothing's ever 100% impossible.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And what do you think, Illuga?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Well, I'd say that prevention beats a cure. After all, the latter might come too late.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: As such, I'm planning to build a barbican around the entrance here first.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: That way, even if an enemy does manage to sneak in, it will instantly realize they've fallen into my trap.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Next, I can build several defensive towers around said barbican. Taking blind spots into account... eight watchtowers should do the trick.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: If we make full use of the materials, we could build a fortress that rivals the walls of Piramida. Just leave it to me.

choices.text: It's good that you have things you want to do too.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Oh right! That reminds me, we need to build a granary, and stock it with half a year's worth of provisions for everyone.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Dad said that when it comes to war, most are about which side can hold out longer.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: No way can we lose because of something like that!

choices.text: I won't let any monsters in.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: And I trust you, of course, but you can't possibly anticipate everything.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Maybe monsters could take the form of someone you know, then sneak in when you're not paying attention.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Illuga.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Good morning, sleep well last night?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I just caught a fish. What would you say to some fish soup for today's breakfast?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Illuga.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Mhm, get some rest now.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Quiet night. Looks like I won't need to keep watch. Sleep well.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Not bad at all — in fact, it looks quite sturdy. Every bit as practical as the fortifications our logistics unit has built.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Don't let this haphazard collection of materials fool you. When combined in just the right way, they can withstand even the most ferocious of enemy onslaughts.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: This knowledge comes from precious lessons learned in the heat of battle.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The furnishings may be simple, but they lend the space a warm and cozy air... As soon as I arrived, I felt completely relaxed.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: In fact, I feel more at home in places like this. Luxury and opulence leave me feeling awkward and out of place.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: It's just a shame there's nowhere to cook... Are you hungry, by the way?
